page.content:
Ranchette owner whose angels are legally not angels.

How Old Woman Josie connects

  • Faction: angels — The angels live with Old Woman Josie.
  • Location: Night Vale — Old Woman Josie lives on a ranch outside Night Vale.

What is Old Woman Josie?

Old Woman Josie lives outside town with beings the City Council insists are not angels, a quiet neighbor who keeps Night Vale's most official miracle in a yard.

Key threads lead to angels and Night Vale.
